desc: Shopify unified search and recommendation into a single product semantic token (SID) generation model and reported a 7.95% increase in orders in a Shop app home feed A/B test.
Pinterest turned on multi-epoch training for its home feed ranking model by freezing the embedding table in the first epoch, and reported a 1.09% gain in online saves.
